designSystem.grid: 8px spacing system with 4px sub-steps for fine control

typography.fontFamily: Inter, SF Pro Text, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

components: Button variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger
Input default state with label/value structure
Chart cards: bar trend and donut breakdown

interactionSpecs.button: 120ms ease-out color/border/transform transition; hover raises by 1px; minimum tap target 44px.
interactionSpecs.card: 20px radius, 24px padding, subtle border, optional glass blur, card elevation.
interactionSpecs.expenseEntry: Desktop modal pattern; mobile bottom sheet pattern.
interactionSpecs.charts: Tooltips on hover/tap; legends use labels plus color dots.
interactionSpecs.calendar: Selected day updates inspector on desktop; agenda list on mobile.
interactionSpecs.accessibility: Do not rely only on color for status; use labels such as healthy, watch, over.
